AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Trusted administrator marker document keyed by admin UID.

userId.description: The UID of the admin user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin document was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public group member profile and moderation status (no PII stored).

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

groupId.description: Group partition identifier for query enforcement.

username.description: Display username in SMART CHAT (1-40 chars).

avatarData.description: Preset avatar key or compressed lightweight Base64 thumbnail.

statusText.description: Short user bio or status message.

isBlocked.description: Whether the user has been blocked by the Admin.

isOnline.description: Whether the user is currently active in SMART CHAT.

isAdminBadge.description: Whether the user holds the verified Admin badge.

autoDeleteHours.description: Preferred message auto-delete retention window in hours (24 or 48).

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A group text, voice note, or admin notice message with automatic 24-48h expiration.

groupId.description: Group partition identifier for query enforcement.

senderId.description: UID of the user who sent the message.

senderAvatar.description: Avatar identifier or lightweight Base64 thumbnail of the sender.

senderIsAdmin.description: True if sent by the verified Admin.

type.description: Message type: text, voice, or notice.

text.description: Text content of the message or voice note caption.

audioBase64.description: Base64-encoded compressed audio payload for voice messages.

audioDurationSec.description: Duration of the voice message in seconds (0-120).

replyToId.description: Optional ID of the message being replied to.

replyToSender.description: Optional display name of the user being replied to.

replyToPreview.description: Optional short text preview of the message being replied to.

ttlHours.description: Auto-delete time-to-live in hours (24 or 48) for Free Plan optimization.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Group member profiles and block status.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Group chat text messages, voice notes, and pinned admin notices.
